Some parts of the software have not been updated for many years and it is like working with a dinosaur - a[G2 review](https://www.g2.com/products/upland-qvidian/reviews/upland-qvidian-review-10812284) .

Its AI Assist feature sits on top of a library-and-keyword design, which is where the slow search, constant upkeep, and dated interface come from.

If you are already deployed on Qvidian and migration would cost more than the friction, the last section covers when staying makes sense.

## Why should you consider Qvidian competitors or alternatives?


Teams move off Qvidian mainly because AI was added to a library-based design, which leads to slow search, heavy upkeep, and a dated interface.


- **Legacy foundation:** Qvidian is an established enterprise proposal platform that predates the current AI era.
- **Add-on AI:** Qvidian AI Assist, which autofills, revises, and drafts content, arrived later as an extension rather than part of the core design.
- **Library-and-keyword engine:** Answers come from a structured central library and keyword matching, not from AI reasoning over the incoming document.
- **Slow answer hunting:** Users report that finding the right answer in the library takes real time when search results lack precision.
- **Heavy implementation:** Setup and configuration can be demanding, especially for teams managing many merge codes and integrations.
- **Dated experience:** Reviewers describe an interface and document builder that need too many clicks.
- **Rigid formatting:** Some teams struggled to produce RFPs that meet strict formatting requirements.

## 1. Inventive AI (best for AI-native drafting with no library to maintain)


Inventive AI is an AI-native, agentic platform for[RFPs](https://www.inventive.ai/solution/ai-rfp-response-software) ,[RFIs](https://www.inventive.ai/solution/ai-rfi-response-software) ,[DDQs](https://www.inventive.ai/solution/ddq-automation-software) ,[security questionnaires](https://www.inventive.ai/solution/ai-security-questionnaire-software) , and[narrative proposals](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/announcing-narrative-style-proposal-support-elevate-your-rfp-responses-with-inventive-ai) , and a human approves every response. It was founded by leaders from Google DeepMind and Stanford AI, is backed by Y Combinator, and fits sales, solutions engineering, and[presales teams](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/ai-for-presales-teams) that want stronger first drafts without a library to maintain. Because answers are generated from connected knowledge, most of the upkeep Qvidian demands disappears.


### Why Inventive AI is the best alternative to Upland Qvidian


Qvidian is a traditional proposal platform, while Inventive AI is AI native. Teams leave Qvidian mainly because of a dated interface, slow library search, limited AI, and a learning curve that hits occasional contributors hardest.


#### 1. Friendly UX compared to a dated interface


Recent reviewers say Qvidian feels like legacy software rather than a modern SaaS platform: an[enterprise healthcare user](https://www.g2.com/products/upland-qvidian/reviews/upland-qvidian-review-10812284) compared parts of the product to a dinosaur, and a[financial services reviewer](https://www.g2.com/products/upland-qvidian/reviews/upland-qvidian-review-11280618) said the UI feels like legacy software.


**How Inventive AI handles it:** Qvidian is built around a content library. Inventive AI is AI native, so drafting, source selection, and review happen in a[single workflow](https://www.inventive.ai/features/response-generation) .


#### 2. Fast answer retrieval compared to slow library search


Finding the right answer in Qvidian's library takes longer than reviewers expect: a[financial services reviewer](https://www.g2.com/products/upland-qvidian/reviews/upland-qvidian-review-11781947) called it time consuming with a relatively basic interface, and a[contract technical editor](https://www.g2.com/products/upland-qvidian/reviews/upland-qvidian-review-12816131) said search needs better filters.


**How Inventive AI handles it:** Our AI context engine draws on the RFP document, project instructions, tone and voice, and meeting notes, and picks sources by relevance and recency. The[knowledge hub](https://www.inventive.ai/features/knowledge-hub) connects to SharePoint, Google Drive, Confluence, Notion, Zendesk, Salesforce, and Slack, and reads documents as they are, with no conversion into Q&A pairs.


#### 3. AI-native drafting compared to limited AI and rigid templates


Reviewers want more AI and more flexibility in templates and analytics: an[HR customer](https://www.g2.com/products/upland-qvidian/reviews/upland-qvidian-review-10824390) said Qvidian needs more AI features, and a[banking customer](https://www.g2.com/products/upland-qvidian/reviews/upland-qvidian-review-10852122) wanted more personalized templates.


**How Inventive AI handles it:** Traditional platforms add AI on top of a library, while Inventive AI is AI native. Drafts are grounded in connected company knowledge with[source citations](https://www.inventive.ai/faq/ai-rfp-answer-source-citations-confidence-scores) , and a conflict-detection agent[flags outdated or contradictory answers](https://www.inventive.ai/faq/rfp-knowledge-base-stale-duplicate-answers) before a buyer sees them. It also returns the buyer's questionnaire in its original format, so an[Excel questionnaire](https://www.inventive.ai/rfp-software-faq/how-ai-handles-excel-questionnaires) comes back as that same file with answers filled in.


#### 4. A shallow learning curve compared to a steep one for occasional users


Qvidian works best for dedicated power users, and reviewers say everyone else struggles:[Sean N.](https://www.g2.com/products/upland-qvidian/reviews/upland-qvidian-review-12235075) said first-time users get too little direction on basic functions, and a[manufacturing customer](https://www.g2.com/products/upland-qvidian/reviews/upland-qvidian-review-12820727) said Projects is complex for people who are not active on the platform.


**How Inventive AI handles it:**[Usage-based pricing](https://www.inventive.ai/inventive-ai-pricing) starts at $830/month, billed annually, with unlimited users, so SMEs, security teams, and sellers can collaborate without seat fees or heavy training.


#### 5. Fast, light implementation compared to heavy setup and slower support


Reviewers describe complex implementation, and some say support responsiveness declined after the acquisition.
**How Inventive AI handles it:** With no library to populate first, setup starts from your existing documents. Druva onboarded 120+ sales team members in 3 weeks.

## Frequently Asked Questions


### Qvidian vs Responsive: which should an enterprise choose?


Both are library-based platforms built before generative AI, so the comparison comes down to scale and Office integration rather than drafting quality. Responsive has the larger install base and broader workflow features. Qvidian has deeper Microsoft Office integration and stronger roots in financial services. If library upkeep is the problem you are actually trying to solve, neither one answers it, and an AI-native platform like Inventive AI that drafts from connected knowledge is the better shortlist.


### What is Qvidian?


Qvidian is a proposal and RFP response platform from Upland Software. It stores approved answers in a curated library and matches them to new questions, mostly inside Microsoft Word and Excel, and it is common in financial services, insurance, healthcare, and manufacturing. AI-native alternatives like Inventive AI generate answers from connected company knowledge instead of retrieving them from a library.


### What do Qvidian reviews say?


Reviewers praise its governance, audit trail, and native Office fit. Complaints cluster around a dated interface, slow search, complex implementation, constant library upkeep, and slower support since the Upland acquisition. Read recent G2 reviews from teams of your size and industry, and ask shortlisted vendors for matching references.


### Is Qvidian a good fit for small businesses?


Usually not, because it is built for large, regulated organizations. Third-party data puts the median Qvidian license near $24,875 a year before implementation, migration, and training. Small teams tend to do better with volume-based pricing and no seat fees, and Inventive AI starts at $830 per month, billed annually, with unlimited users.


### Which Qvidian alternatives suit enterprises with strict compliance needs?


Look for human approval on every response, source citations, role-based permissions, and conflict detection. Inventive AI includes review workflows, approval assignments, role-based permissions, citations, and conflict detection. Test each shortlisted tool on one of your own compliance documents.


### Can I replace Qvidian without losing my audit trail?


Yes, as long as the new tool records who drafted, reviewed, and approved each answer and ties every answer to its source. Inventive AI, for example, offers audit trail and version control on every response. The exception is teams that must assemble and audit the final document natively inside Word, so test that workflow in a demo first.


### How does Qvidian compare with QorusDocs?


Qvidian centers on library-based answer management for RFPs and questionnaires, while QorusDocs centers on assembling branded proposals inside Microsoft Office from approved content. Document assembly points to QorusDocs, and answer quality and library upkeep point to an AI-native tool like Inventive AI.


### Does Qvidian have an API, and what do alternatives integrate with?


Third-party sources report that API access and SSO are often priced as add-ons, so confirm what your quote covers. Inventive AI connects to Google Drive, SharePoint, OneDrive, Confluence, Notion, Zendesk, Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, and Microsoft Teams.


### What is the best AI software for responding to RFPs and RFQs?


Inventive AI is our pick for question-heavy RFPs, RFIs, DDQs, and security questionnaires, plus narrative proposals. It drafts cited answers from your connected knowledge, and humans approve every response. For RFQs driven mostly by pricing and quoting logic, check that the tool covers your pricing workflow first.


### Which tools give teams fast access to verified answers?


Tools that cite the source of every answer and flag outdated or conflicting content get you verified answers fastest. Inventive AI shows source citations and confidence scores, flags conflicts before they reach a buyer, and its strategic agents can research competitors and develop win themes. Library-based tools depend on how recently someone reviewed each entry.


### Which proposal software is most reliable based on reviews?


On G2, Inventive AI rates 4.9/5 and AutoRFP.ai 4.8/5 among the best RFP software options reviewed. Compare review counts as well as scores, and read reviews from teams like yours. A live test on your own document is more reliable than any rating.
